name: cli-templates-list
body: `kalide templates` lists every template in the deck's merged library (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory; see layered-template-library) with its name, kind (slide|section — derived from whether it lives under the library's `slides/` or `sections/`) and one-line description. A template whose `template.yaml` declares `internal: true` (internal-templates) is omitted from the default listing and included only when `--all` is passed. Run outside a project (no resolvable library) it errors per templates-dir-required.
